name: seal
behavior: Flaps toward the nearest player at 4.0 u/s (pursuit ceiling 0.60 - never above 5.4 u/s while flapping); between 4 u and 12 u it stops and telegraphs for 0.75 s (dashed red 3D line fixed from its body centre through the player's centre), barks on tick 0 of the dash and dashes 20 u in 1.0 s along the fixed line, then idles 0.75 s. Contact at any time = kill.
counter_play: Jump on the bark - your feet are more than 1.2 u above their telegraph-start height from 0.12 s to 0.63 s after take-off, a 0.51 s window for its 0.07 s body crossing. A 3 HU step (1.5 u, up or down) also clears it; a sidestep >= 0.7 u works on a 2-wide path or platform.
tell: Mouth-open frame held for 0.75 s with a dashed red line drawn along the fixed 3D dash line, brightening until the bark - the line never re-aims.
